question: Should the team use the emergency hotfix or the staged rollback?
context: Policy R2 requires a customer-impacting incident to be mitigated within 20 minutes. A mitigation must preserve queued writes unless the incident commander explicitly approves data loss.

evidence.text: The new release causes 3.5% of writes to fail. The incident began seven minutes ago.
A hotfix takes 25 minutes to build and validate.
A rollback takes six minutes. Draining the write queue first takes four minutes and prevents data loss. The incident commander is available now.

fields.name: mitigated_in
fields.description: minutes from incident start until mitigation

fields.name: data_loss_approved
fields.description: has the incident commander explicitly approved data loss

fields.name: queue_drained
fields.description: is the queue drained before rollback
